# PROC001: process-outside-exec

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

A crate outside the repository's declared spawners uses a process-spawning API.

A repository-local policy: only repositories that list crates in
`[check] process_spawners` are checked, so consumers never see it. Matches
`Command`, `Child`, `Stdio` and exec/spawn APIs, never `ExitCode`, `exit`
or `id`. Move the call into a listed crate or route it through
`gob_exec::Runner`.

## Examples

### PROC001 process spawn outside the spawner crates / A spawn in an unlisted crate fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
process_spawners = ["gob-exec"]
=== crates/other/src/lib.rs
//! Other.
use std::process::Command;
```

### PROC001 process spawn outside the spawner crates / An exit code in an unlisted crate is clean #2 (line 19) (clean)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
process_spawners = ["gob-exec"]
=== crates/other/src/lib.rs
//! Other.
use std::process::ExitCode;
```
